annotations.annotation_text: Bibliographic notice: Published simultaneously on May 4, 1939, by Faber and Faber Ltd (London) and The Viking Press (New York). A deluxe signed limited edition of 428 copies (numbered and signed by Joyce) was printed on English handmade paper by R. MacLehose & Co. Ltd. at The University Press, Glasgow.
sources: Slocum, John J., and Herbert Cahoon. A Bibliography of James Joyce. Yale University Press, 1953.
Connolly, Thomas E. The Personal Library of James Joyce. University of Buffalo, 1957.
